findings.detail: The rate-fill warning counts source-declared N/A(6) direct-lending rows with zero principal and negative cost/fair value as missing extracted rates, while adjacent coupon-bearing rows have stated rates.

rationale: This is an aggregate dl_rate_fill review. The source SOI has explicit Interest Rate columns, and direct-lending rows with actual coupons are populated, e.g. ABC Legal Holdings row 23 shows SF + 4.25% and 7.92%. The adjacent ABC Legal rows 24 and 25 are separate One stop rows where the source itself prints N/A(6), zero principal, and negative amortized cost/fair value. Roam for N/A/N/A(6) returned many identical source-declared N/A debt rows across the SOI. The flag therefore reflects the check treating source N/A rows as rate-fill violations, not an extraction/data error.
